method.wall: fresh process including spawn/exit; OS file caches not flushed; routes interleaved
method.memory: wait4 ru_maxrss; per-child high-water statistic, not aggregate process-tree RSS; MiB
method.phases: native --timings; compiler_load is Wasmtime JIT of compiler.wasm; compiler_execute is the compiler's _start including its own setup and source-to-Wasm work
method.compute: warm compiled module; instantiate + _start; first run discarded; worker peak RSS includes JIT and all iterations
method.packages: unpublished local archives; offline installs; cached launches; public registry/network costs unmeasured

packages/local-first-use.note: one observation each; local archives/no network; Bun shares the npm-installed local tree, so no Bun install time measured
